AssistantOut.description:
What whoever asks in a chat may choose for an answer, and what an answer is given when
nothing is chosen.
AssistantOut.title: AssistantOut

CardKind.description:
The cards code puts under a message of Tamga's, as a client knows them: what the card
is about says which record its id names.
CardKind.title: CardKind

CardMessage.description:
A card code put in a chat, carried as the chat protocol's activity message. A client
draws it from the record it names, which it reads like any other.
CardMessage.title: CardMessage

ChatMessages.description:
A chat's messages as the chat protocol (AG-UI) carries them, oldest first: what a client
hands its runtime to show the chat. The server keeps its own copy and never reads a client's
back (ADR-0006).
ChatMessages.title: ChatMessages

CompactionMessage.description:
Where a chat was compacted, carried as an activity message: runs are sent notes in place
of the messages above it, which a reader still sees.
CompactionMessage.title: CompactionMessage

CompanyMode.description: What Tamga may do for the company (ADR-0009).
CompanyMode.title: CompanyMode

DocumentBrief.description: A linked file, for the project's timeline: when and how it came.
DocumentBrief.title: DocumentBrief

DocumentPartOut.description: A file in an archive, under the name it had there.
DocumentPartOut.title: DocumentPartOut

FieldSource.description: Where an editable field's value came from; the owner's always wins (ADR-0010).
FieldSource.title: FieldSource

Holder.description:
What keeps a file besides the uploads of it: a mail it came in, a project it is evidence
on.
Holder.title: Holder

HtmlOut.description: A web page made safe to show, for a frame that runs no script.
HtmlOut.title: HtmlOut

InvoiceBrief.description: A linked invoice, for the project's timeline.
InvoiceBrief.title: InvoiceBrief

JobReading.description: What a model read in a conversation: a proposal for the owner, never a fact.
JobReading.title: JobReading

LinkCreate.description: The owner attaching an item to a project by hand: confirmed at once.
LinkCreate.title: LinkCreate

LocationContact.description:
Who is asked where the truck is: its dispatcher when it has one (who already talks to the
driver), otherwise the driver (ADR-0011).
LocationContact.title: LocationContact

Me.description: Who is signed in, the company this session acts for, and every company they belong to.
Me.title: Me

MessageBrief.description: A linked mail, for the project's timeline.
MessageBrief.title: MessageBrief

Origin.description: Who began a chat, or a run in one (ADR-0018). Either way it is an ordinary chat.
Origin.title: Origin

Outcome.description: What the linker made of a conversation (docs/architecture/09).
Outcome.title: Outcome

PlacementDecision.description:
The owner's answer, one of two. ``links``: every link that waits between the conversation's
mails and its project is confirmed or rejected. ``project_id``: the conversation belongs to
this project, whatever was suggested; with ``from_project_id`` it is moved there.
PlacementDecision.title: PlacementDecision

PlacementOut.description: Where the linker placed a conversation, and why.
PlacementOut.title: PlacementOut

Preview.description: How the web app shows a file; a file with none is only downloaded.
Preview.title: Preview

ProjectJob.description:
The job as the project's conversations describe it together, worked out by code from what
a model read in each: for each field what most of them say, and each firm in one role only.
Firms go by their short names; the parties keep their full ones.
ProjectJob.title: ProjectJob

ProjectMerge.description: The owner saying this project and ``into`` are one job: ``into`` stays.
ProjectMerge.title: ProjectMerge

ProjectStage.description: Where the job stands, in order. Computed from its shipments and invoices, never typed.
ProjectStage.title: ProjectStage

ReadState.description:
Whether Tamga has read what a file says (ADR-0012). A document nobody asked to read (an
inline logo) has none.
ReadState.title: ReadState

Reason.description: Why a file could not be read, as the owner is told (ADR-0012).
Reason.title: Reason

ThreadSummary.description: A conversation: every mail sharing a thread key, a copy in another mailbox counted once.
ThreadSummary.title: ThreadSummary

APIKeyCookie.description: Set by signing in, accepting an invite or opening a guest sandbox.
APIKeyCookie.name: tamga_session

get.description:
The model and reasoning effort a chat's answers are given, and the others a question
may be sent with: a run takes the choice in the protocol's `forwardedProps`, as
`{"model": …, "effort": …}`.
The company's chats: those this user has not read first, then the most recent.

post.description: Opens a chat. Sent again with the same id, it gives the chat that id already opened.

Writes the chat's earlier part into notes, which its runs are then sent in place of
those messages. It happens by itself before a run once the chat nears its window.

Answers the message the body carries, as a stream of the chat protocol's events (AG-UI).
The body is the protocol's run input; of its messages only the last, the new one, is read.

200.description: The run's AG-UI events, as they come

delete.description: Stops the answer being written in the chat, when one is.

get.description: Newest first, by when each file arrived or was last uploaded.

delete.description:
An uploaded file, with what was read from it. 409 when a mail brought it or a project holds
it as evidence (`held_by`).

patch.description:
Its type or the name Tamga shows it under; only the fields sent change. A new name keeps the
extension (400), and a file a mail or an archive brought keeps the name it came with (409,
`held_by`).

get.description: The file itself, for the web app to draw: inline only as a verified image or PDF.

A web page (`preview` html) made safe to show, as a mail's body is: for a frame that runs
no script and loads nothing from the web unless asked.

The files taken out of an archive or a winmail.dat, in their order there, each under the
name it had in it. Empty until the archive is read (`read_state`).
The PDF the converter made of a Word, RTF or OpenDocument file (`converted`).

A spreadsheet as Excel lays it out: each cell's value and number format, the styles, merged
cells, widths and heights. At most 20 sheets of a thousand rows and fifty columns.
An XML or text file (`preview` text) as text, up to a million characters.
The mail as its server gave it (.eml), headers and every part, for a mail client.
Conversations, the most recently active first; ``q`` matches any of their mails.

post.description: What Tamga wrote, in another language: read from what is kept, written once by a model.
